summary: Of the 22 held works, ZERO adapt a chapter of Aoyama's Detective Conan manga — the shelf is entirely original material, and two independent sources say so for every entry. The shape is a rule, not a coincidence: Detective Conan's manga cases are animated as TV episodes, while the film / OVA / tie-in shelf is written by the anime's own screenwriters. ja-WP's OVA list states it outright for the Shonen Sunday 応募者全員サービス line — 「…第1作目・第4作目、…第12作目…以外は、全てオリジナルエピソードである」 — and DCW's OVA infobox carries a `manga` field that is FILLED on exactly those exceptions and absent on all the rest, so its absence is a positive reading rather than silence. The MAGIC FILE / BONUS FILE discs are 「劇場版とリンクするストーリーを収録したオリジナルDVDシリーズ」 (pre-/post-stories for that year's film); the two Suntory IMAX 3D shorts are event-only Kid heists; both Lupin crossovers are 前川淳 screenplays with the two franchises' creators credited as 原作; film 29 is a 大倉崇裕 original (ja-WP states the rule for the whole film line: 「ストーリー自体は劇場版独自のもの」); and the 2026 Precure crossover special is marked `TV Original` by DCW and アニメオリジナル by ja-WP's 原作 column. TWO works DO adapt a chapter — but of a DIFFERENT Aoyama run, so they are `no` here and `other_instrument` for decision (d): OVA 1 expands Magic Kaito vol 3's 「刃vs.快斗!」 and OVA 12 adapts the 1988 one-shot 「えくすかりばあ」 (青山剛昌短編集). A negative check backs every row: ja-WP's complete manga-episode list — every case of the manga with its anime episode number — contains no case matching any of these 22 titles, and its アニメ column never names an OVA or a film.

flags_for_sean: OTHER_INSTRUMENT (decision (d)), two works. OVA 1 'Conan vs. Kid vs. Yaiba' (AniList 1369) is an expanded adaptation of MAGIC KAITO vol 3 「刃vs.快斗!」 — DCW: 'the original manga version of the story featured no characters from the Detective Conan cast, as it had been written and published before even the first chapter of Conan'; OVA 12 'The Miracle of Excalibur' (13839) adapts 「えくすかりばあ」, a 28-page 1988 one-shot in 週刊少年サンデー増刊 collected in 『青山剛昌短編集』. Both are FILLER against the Detective Conan instrument. Magic Kaito is the one worth a ruling: it is the Kaitou Kid source and an I41 chain candidate for this franchise; the Excalibur one-shot is an unrelated baseball story with Conan characters grafted on.

A SIBLING IS MISSING FROM THE HELD SET. OVA 4 「コナンとキッドとクリスタル・マザー」 (2004-03-03) is the OTHER Magic Kaito adaptation (DCW: `manga = Magic Kaito Volume 4: Chapter 1`; ja-WP's exemption sentence names 第1作目・第4作目) and it is NOT among the 22 works handed to me. ANILIST DATES DISAGREE WITH BOTH WIKIS ON SIX OVAs, and the cause is structural: the 応募者全員サービス OVAs were mail-order items with an APPLICATION WINDOW, not a broadcast date (e.g. OVA 12 was available 2012-04-11 → 2012-06-06). DCW and ja-WP use the window's OPEN. Stored/AniList vs DCW: 2512 2002-01-30 vs 2002-01-16 · 2597 2007-03-13 vs 2007-03-14 · 6198 2008-01-01 (a placeholder) vs 2008-03-12 · 6438 2009-06-17 vs 2009-04-15 · 10703 2011-05-30 vs 2011-04-13 · 13839 2012-05-24 vs 2012-04-11. The other sixteen agree to the day. If the ledger's position is date-derived, six positions move — this is a date-regime fork for Sean, not a per-work repair.

POSITION CONFIRMED for 'The Gold-Star Answer' (212994) @1202.5. The licensor gives it NO episode number — ytv's 事件ファイル page tags it 「#特別編」 while 2026-05-30 is 「#1202」 and 2026-06-13 is 「#1203」 — and ja-WP's episode table prints 話数 = 特別編 in exactly that slot. It is correctly a related work, not an episode row. WARNING for whoever touches this row: DCW's infobox says `int-episode = 1262`, which is the INTERNATIONAL count (it splits hour specials and runs ~50 ahead of our JP row space, which is at 1212) — never key a Conan row by it.

THE MAGIC FILE / BONUS FILE DISCS BUNDLE OLD TV EPISODES. Each disc pairs the new OVA with previously aired episodes as PPV extras, and MAGIC FILE 1 (2007) is nothing BUT old episodes — DCW: 'No new material in this Magic File, which only contained episodes 132-134, 196, 266-268, and 291-293' (ja-WP excludes it from its OVA table for that reason). Magic File 1 is not in the held set, which is right. But if a ledger row is ever the DISC rather than the new short, its bundled content is a duplicate of TV rows — a recap (N8), never new adaptation.

THE WIDER SHELF HOLDS ONE GENUINE 'YES' THAT IS NOT IN THIS SET. 「逃亡者・毛利小五郎」 (NOTTV web anime, April 2014, made for movie 18's release) is the FIRST animation of the manga's 「逃亡者」 — ja-WP's manga-episode list gives it as entry 173, a 番外 (unnumbered extra) in volume 57 with the footnote 「2007年1月に掲載された原作からしばらくの間アニメ化されなかったが、7年を経た2014年4月に…NOTTVにて「逃亡者・毛利小五郎」のタイトルで配信（初アニメ化）された」. If it ever surfaces as a related work it is canon — and, being a 番外 with no File number, it is a `side_story` FACT naming the vol-57 extra, never a numbered anchor. Also absent from this held set: films 1-28, the numbered TV specials, the vs Wooo web shorts, the planetarium works and the 小学館図鑑 appendix OVAs — worth checking whether they are held elsewhere.

TRAP CONFIRMED FOR THE CATALOG: on Detective Conan, AniList's `source: MANGA` is pure franchise tagging. It sits on eleven of these works (including 'Kid in Trap Island', which AniList's own synopsis calls 'an entirely new story produced specifically for the DVD') and is ABSENT from the two works that actually do adapt a chapter of something (OVA 1 and both Lupin crossovers read `source: null`). The tag is anti-correlated with the truth here.
